mapper.sql: r.id,r.tenant_id AS tenantId,r.source_message_id AS sourceMessageId,r.customer_id AS customerId,r.staff_user_id AS staffUserId,r.team_id AS teamId,r.corp_id AS corpId,r.external_userid AS externalUserid,r.conversation_id AS conversationId,r.status,r.reason_masked AS reasonMasked,r.reply_cipher AS replyCipher,r.intent,r.risk_flags_json AS riskFlagsJson,r.ai_provider AS aiProvider,r.ai_model AS aiModel,r.send_provider AS sendProvider,r.provider_message_id AS providerMessageId,r.send_attempted_at AS sendAttemptedAt,r.generation_attempts AS generationAttempts,r.send_attempts AS sendAttempts,r.next_attempt_at AS nextAttemptAt,r.lease_owner AS leaseOwner,r.lease_expires_at AS leaseExpiresAt,r.created_at AS createdAt,r.updated_at AS updatedAt,r.version

choose.when: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_customer cu WHERE cu.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND cu.id=r.customer_id AND cu.deleted=0 AND (cu.owner_staff_id=#{selfId} OR cu.team_id IN #{teamId})AND cu.owner_staff_id=#{selfId}) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user su WHERE su.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND su.id=r.staff_user_id AND (su.id=#{selfId} OR su.team_id IN #{teamId})AND su.id=#{selfId})

mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId,enabled,emergency_stopped AS emergencyStopped,min_interval_seconds AS minIntervalSeconds, daily_limit AS dailyLimit,allowed_start AS allowedStart,allowed_end AS allowedEnd,zone_id AS zoneId, blocked_terms_json AS blockedTermsJson,version FROM crm_ai_chat_delegation_policy WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId}

SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId,enabled,emergency_stopped AS emergencyStopped,min_interval_seconds AS minIntervalSeconds, daily_limit AS dailyLimit,allowed_start AS allowedStart,allowed_end AS allowedEnd,zone_id AS zoneId, blocked_terms_json AS blockedTermsJson,version FROM crm_ai_chat_delegation_policy WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT scope_type AS scopeType,scope_id AS scopeId,enabled FROM crm_ai_chat_delegation_scope WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} ORDER BY scope_type,scope_id
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_ai_chat_delegation_policy SET enabled=#{e.enabled},emergency_stopped=#{e.emergencyStopped}, min_interval_seconds=#{e.minIntervalSeconds},daily_limit=#{e.dailyLimit},allowed_start=#{e.allowedStart}, allowed_end=#{e.allowedEnd},zone_id=#{e.zoneId},blocked_terms_json=#{blockedTermsJson},updated_by=#{actorUserId}, version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{e.tenantId} AND version=#{expectedVersion}

UPDATE crm_ai_chat_delegation_customer SET mode=#{mode},reason=#{reason},updated_by=#{actorUserId},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND customer_id=#{customerId} AND version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_ai_chat_delegation_run r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.customer_id=#{customerId} AND r.status IN ('QUEUED','DEFERRED','RETRY_GENERATE','READY_TO_SEND','RETRY_SEND') ORDER BY r.id FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM crm_ai_chat_delegation_run r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.source_message_id=#{sourceMessageId}
SELECT FROM crm_ai_chat_delegation_run r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.id=#{id}
SELECT FROM crm_ai_chat_delegation_run r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id FROM crm_ai_chat_delegation_run WHERE status IN ('QUEUED','DEFERRED','RETRY_GENERATE','READY_TO_SEND','RETRY_SEND') OR (status IN ('GENERATING','SENDING') AND lease_expires_at<#{now})
SELECT FROM crm_ai_chat_delegation_run r WHERE r.status='SENDING' AND r.lease_expires_at<#{now} ORDER BY r.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_ai_chat_delegation_run SET send_attempted_at=#{now},updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='SENDING' AND lease_owner=#{owner}
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(send_attempted_at) FROM crm_ai_chat_delegation_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND customer_id=#{customerId} AND send_attempted_at IS NOT NULL
SELECT r.status,COUNT(*) AS count FROM crm_ai_chat_delegation_run r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND GROUP BY r.status
